notices.title: Exclusive Exodus TLC Mission Footage | New Gameplay Today
notices.contentSnippet:
Welcome to a New Gameplay Today, with an exclusive new look at some gameplay of the upcoming sci-fi RPG Exodus. As part of our cover story, we got to play a slice of the early game story, where Jun and their companions take back the Traveler Launch Center (TLC) from some hostile enemies, while also reclaiming some of Jun's inherited powers.
Charles and Eric take you through all the major beats, including the mech-driving octopus Salt's potent abilities and a big boss fight against the massive robot Redeemer. Keep an eye out for our last bits of video coverage in the coming days, and enjoy a fresh new look at Exodus here.
